notes: Job Agent v2.9.17 beta adds in-app application response analytics and manual follow-up reminders on top of the already tested v2.9.16 employer response tracker. The Applications tab now counts distinct confirmed submissions, user-recorded recruiter replies, current scheduled/completed interviews, rejections, and offers; applications are deduplicated by canonical Jobs.cz/Prace.cz IDs. The local next_date in employer_responses.json drives an upcoming-action list for overdue/due reminders and next seven days, with optional future-dated tasks. Date-only reminders become due on the specified day, and timestamp reminders become due only at the entered local time. Double-click or use the button to open the corresponding vacancy on Dashboard without contacting the employer or reopening an application. Closed rejections and withdrawals are excluded from action lists; old records with no response data still work. Reminders are visible only while the app is open: no background notifications, no Gmail reads and no automatic follow-up emails. Existing scoring, submit authorization and history are unchanged. GitHub Actions CI: 84/84 offline Qt and regression tests passed.
